summary: Email field feature in BookingPage Step 4 tested and verified. Found and fixed CRITICAL BUG: clientEmail state was not declared (ReferenceError). After fix, all 12 features tested and passed: email input visible with Mail icon, type='email', placeholder 'primer@mail.com', invalid email shows red error 'Unesite validnu email adresu', confirm button disabled when email empty/invalid, enabled when valid email+name+phone provided. Backend: POST /api/reservations accepts client_email, returns it in response, returns 422 if missing, stores lowercase. GET /api/reservations returns client_email (empty string for old reservations). Full booking flow works end-to-end with email. IPS QR code still appears on confirmation page.
